page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources per vCPU. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 80 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high-density resource profile offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high network throughput, the ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, and distributed caching systems. The dedicated CPU architecture also makes it appropriate for multi-threaded processing tasks and mid-sized database deployments that do not require local NVMe storage.
